name: Mogami Youko
source:
An outgoing girl who starts a club to explore the supernatural with her friends Kei and Meina. It's also to help Meina overcome her crippling shyness. She invites Susumu to the club since he's a classmate who's not doing anything and to meet the minimum requirement of members.

Her 'favorite number' is 16.
